ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface is composed almost entirely of low-intensity pixels (black) with a near-zero ratio of high-intensity white pigmentation.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely sharp, pointed distal tips at the lateral extremities of the fluke lobes.
